856175.name: FCY1
856175.summary: Enables cytosine deaminase activity. Involved in cytidine metabolic process; cytosine metabolic process; and pyrimidine-containing compound salvage. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856183.name: MED1
856183.summary: Predicted to enable transcription coregulator activity. Involved in RNA polymerase II preinitiation complex assembly and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Part of core mediator complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856232.name: RRG8
856232.summary: Involved in mitochondrial tRNA 5'-end processing. Located in matrix side of mitochondrial inner membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856236.name: CLB2
856236.summary: Enables cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase regulator activity. Involved in DNA damage response; G2/M transition of mitotic cell cycle; and regulation of cell cycle process. Located in several cellular components, including cellular bud neck; microtubule cytoskeleton; and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast cancer and prostate cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including CCNB1 (cyclin B1) and CCNB2 (cyclin B2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856241.name: CTR1
856241.summary: Enables copper ion transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in copper ion import. Located in plasma membrane. Used to study Menkes disease. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856253.name: MSS18
856253.summary: Involved in Group I intron splicing and mitochondrial mRNA processing. Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856254.name: CTF4
856254.summary: Enables chromatin binding activity and identical protein binding activity. Involved in DNA metabolic process and sister chromatid cohesion. Located in nuclear replication fork. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cholangiocarcinoma. Orthologous to human WDHD1 (WD repeat and HMG-box DNA binding protein 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856260.name: MEP3
856260.summary: Enables ammonium channel activity. Involved in ammonium transmembrane transport and nitrogen utilization. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Rh deficiency syndrome; Rh isoimmunization; hemolytic anemia; and overhydrated hereditary stomatocytosis. Orthologous to several human genes including RHAG (Rh associated glycoprotein); RHCE (Rh blood group CcEe antigens); and RHD (Rh blood group D antigen). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856263.name: KAR3
856263.summary: Enables ATP hydrolysis activity; microtubule binding activity; and minus-end-directed microtubule motor activity. Involved in several processes, including chromosome organization; karyogamy involved in conjugation with cellular fusion; and transport along microtubule. Acts upstream of or within ERAD pathway. Located in cytoplasmic microtubule and spindle pole body. Is active in mitotic spindle pole body. Orthologous to human KIFC1 (kinesin family member C1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856276.name: MAY24
856276.summary: Involved in cellular response to hydrostatic pressure and protein localization to plasma membrane raft. Is active in cortical endoplasmic reticulum and endoplasmic reticulum membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856277.name: PIN3
856277.summary: Involved in negative regulation of Arp2/3 complex-mediated actin nucleation. Located in actin cortical patch. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast cancer; prostate adenocarcinoma; and prostate cancer. Orthologous to human SH3D19 (SH3 domain containing 19) and GRB2 (growth factor receptor bound protein 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856295.name: MRP2
856295.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial small ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 38. Orthologous to human MRPS14 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein S14). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856296.name: MET16
856296.summary: Enables phosphoadenylyl-sulfate reductase (thioredoxin) activity. Involved in glutathione biosynthetic process and sulfate assimilation, phosphoadenylyl sulfate reduction by phosphoadenylyl-sulfate reductase (thioredoxin). Predicted to be located in cytosol. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856315.name: ATG13
856315.description: serine/threonine protein kinase regulatory subunit ATG13
856315.otherdesignations: serine/threonine protein kinase regulatory subunit ATG13
856315.nomenclaturename: serine/threonine protein kinase regulatory subunit ATG13
856315.summary: Enables armadillo repeat domain binding activity; lipid binding activity; and protein kinase regulator activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to nitrogen starvation; macroautophagy; and protein targeting to vacuole. Located in phagophore assembly site and vacuole-isolation membrane contact site. Part of Atg1/ULK1 kinase complex and PAS complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856324.name: OPT2
856324.summary: Enables oligopeptide transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in several processes, including cell redox homeostasis; positive regulation of monopolar cell growth; and vacuole fusion, non-autophagic. Located in Golgi trans cisterna; peroxisome; and plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856342.name: ECM34
856342.summary: Located in cytosol. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856347.name: CBP2
856347.summary: Enables RNA binding activity. Involved in Group I intron splicing and mitochondrial mRNA processing. Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856357.name: WSC4
856357.summary: Enables transmembrane protein transporter activity. Involved in protein targeting to ER; protein targeting to membrane; and response to heat. Located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856375.name: PRS3
856375.summary: Contributes to ribose phosphate diphosphokinase activity. Involved in 5-phosphoribose 1-diphosphate biosynthetic process. Located in cytoplasm. Part of ribose phosphate diphosphokinase complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Arts syndrome; X-linked deafness 1; X-linked recessive disease (multiple); gout; and retinitis pigmentosa. Orthologous to human PRPS1 (phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate synthetase 1) and PRPS2 (phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate synthetase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856381.name: YHL008C
856381.summary: Enables molecular sensor activity. Involved in chloride transport and regulation of chloride transport. Located in fungal-type vacuole. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856386.name: LAG1
856386.summary: Enables sphingosine N-acyltransferase activity. Involved in ceramide biosynthetic process. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Part of acyl-CoA ceramide synthase complex. Used to study hepatocellular carcinoma; steatotic liver disease; and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis 9. Orthologous to several human genes including CERS2 (ceramide synthase 2); CERS4 (ceramide synthase 4); and CERS6 (ceramide synthase 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856387.name: HSE1
856387.summary: Enables protein domain specific binding activity; protein heterodimerization activity; and ubiquitin binding activity. Involved in several processes, including ATP export; ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the multivesicular body sorting pathway; and vacuolar transport. Located in endosome and vacuolar membrane. Part of ESCRT-0 complex. Orthologous to human STAM (signal transducing adaptor molecule) and STAM2 (signal transducing adaptor molecule 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856399.name: SOD2
856399.summary: Enables superoxide dismutase activity. Involved in reactive oxygen species metabolic process. Located in mitochondrial matrix. Used to study Alzheimer's disease; Parkinson's disease; and cancer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including artery disease (multiple); autoimmune disease of musculoskeletal system (multiple); diabetes mellitus (multiple); liver disease (multiple); and optic nerve disease (multiple). Orthologous to human SOD2 (superoxide dismutase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856404.name: ARD1
856404.description: peptide alpha-N-acetyltransferase complex A subunit ARD1
856404.otherdesignations: peptide alpha-N-acetyltransferase complex A subunit ARD1
856404.nomenclaturename: peptide alpha-N-acetyltransferase complex A subunit ARD1
856404.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity. Contributes to protein-N-terminal amino-acid acetyltransferase activity. Involved in N-terminal protein amino acid acetylation and N-terminal protein amino acid propionylation. Part of NatA complex. Used to study Ogden syndrome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Ogden syndrome and syndromic microphthalmia 1. Orthologous to human NAA10 (N-alpha-acetyltransferase 10, NatA catalytic subunit) and NAA11 (N-alpha-acetyltransferase 11, NatA catalytic subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856409.name: YSC84
856409.summary: Enables actin filament binding activity. Involved in actin cortical patch localization; actin filament bundle assembly; and endocytosis. Located in actin cortical patch. Orthologous to human SH3YL1 (SH3 and SYLF domain containing 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856415.name: RPS27B
856415.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in endonucleolytic cleavage of tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA); maturation of SSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA); and ribosomal small subunit assembly. Part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Diamond-Blackfan anemia 17. Orthologous to human RPS27 (ribosomal protein S27) and RPS27L (ribosomal protein S27 like). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856423.name: DAP2
856423.summary: Enables dipeptidyl-peptidase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein processing. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Middle East respiratory syndrome and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human DPP4 (dipeptidyl peptidase 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856426.name: RRM3
856426.summary: Enables DNA helicase activity and centromeric DNA binding activity. Involved in replication fork progression beyond termination site and replication fork reversal. Located in nuclear replication fork. Orthologous to human PIF1 (PIF1 5'-to-3' DNA helicase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856442.name: INM1
856442.summary: Enables inositol monophosphate 1-phosphatase activity. Involved in inositol phosphate catabolic process. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder 59; bipolar disorder; intellectual disability; and schizophrenia. Orthologous to several human genes including IMPA2 (inositol monophosphatase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856463.name: SSF1
856463.summary: Enables rRNA binding activity. Involved in maturation of LSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA) and ribosomal large subunit assembly. Located in nucleolus. Part of preribosome, large subunit precursor. Orthologous to human PPAN-P2RY11 (PPAN-P2RY11 readthrough) and PPAN (peter pan homolog). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856464.name: HTD2
856464.summary: Enables (3R)-hydroxyacyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] dehydratase activity. Predicted to be involved in fatty acid metabolic process. Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856476.name: NMD2
856476.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Involved in DNA recombination and nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, 3'-5' exonucleolytic nonsense-mediated decay. Located in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human UPF2 (UPF2 regulator of nonsense mediated mRNA decay). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856496.name: HXT5
856496.summary: Enables D-glucose transmembrane transporter activity; fructose transmembrane transporter activity; and mannose transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in D-glucose transmembrane transport. Located in plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856504.name: GRE3
856504.summary: Enables D-xylose reductase (NADPH) activity and mRNA binding activity. Involved in cellular response to osmotic stress; cellular response to oxidative stress; and monosaccharide catabolic process. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in 46,XY sex reversal 8; alcohol dependence; congenital bile acid synthesis defect 2; and leukemia (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including AKR1E2 (aldo-keto reductase family 1 member E2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856516.name: COX23
856516.summary: Involved in mitochondrial respiratory chain complex IV assembly. Located in mitochondrion. Is active in mitochondrial intermembrane space. Orthologous to human CHCHD7 (coiled-coil-helix-coiled-coil-helix domain containing 7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856517.name: TOM71
856517.summary: Predicted to enable mitochondrion targeting sequence binding activity. Predicted to contribute to transmembrane protein transporter activity. Involved in protein localization to mitochondrion. Located in mitochondrial outer membrane. Orthologous to human TOMM70 (translocase of outer mitochondrial membrane 70). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856519.name: SET1
856519.summary: Enables RNA binding activity and protein-lysine N-methyltransferase activity. Contributes to histone H3K4 methyltransferase activity. Involved in several processes, including meiosis I cell cycle process; regulation of cell cycle process; and regulation of gene expression. Located in chromosome, telomeric region. Part of Set1C/COMPASS complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in early-onset epilepsy 2 and neurodevelopmental disorder with speech impairment and dysmorphic facies. Orthologous to human SETD1A (SET domain containing 1A, histone lysine methyltransferase) and SETD1B (SET domain containing 1B, histone lysine methyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856524.name: NDT80
856524.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity. Involved in meiotic cell cycle; positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and sporulation. Located in nuclear chromosome. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856527.name: ANS1
856527.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of cell wall. Located in fungal-type vacuole. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856530.name: ARP1
856530.summary: A structural constituent of cytoskeleton. Involved in several processes, including double-strand break repair via break-induced replication; establishment of mitotic spindle orientation; and mitotic spindle orientation checkpoint signaling. Part of dynactin complex. Orthologous to several human genes including ACTR1B (actin related protein 1B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856559.name: RTT107
856559.summary: Enables chromatin binding activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA double-strand break attachment to nuclear envelope; regulation of DNA damage checkpoint; and regulation of DNA double-strand break processing. Located in cell periphery and nucleus. Part of Cul8-RING ubiquitin ligase complex. Is active in site of DNA damage. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856561.name: LIN1
856561.summary: Predicted to be involved in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome. Located in chromatin and nucleus. Part of U5 snRNP. Orthologous to human CD2BP2 (CD2 cytoplasmic tail binding protein 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856569.name: DNA2
856569.description: bifunctional ATP-dependent DNA helicase/ssDNA endodeoxyribonuclease DNA2
856569.otherdesignations: bifunctional ATP-dependent DNA helicase/ssDNA endodeoxyribonuclease DNA2
856569.nomenclaturename: bifunctional ATP-dependent DNA helicase/ssDNA endodeoxyribonuclease DNA2
856569.summary: Enables several functions, including 4 iron, 4 sulfur cluster binding activity; DNA binding activity; and catalytic activity, acting on DNA. Involved in DNA metabolic process and mitotic DNA replication checkpoint signaling. Located in chromosome; cytoplasm; and nucleus. Used to study Bloom syndrome; Seckel syndrome (multiple); Werner syndrome; cancer; and microcephaly. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Seckel syndrome 8; autosomal dominant progressive external ophthalmoplegia with mitochondrial DNA deletions 6; isolated growth hormone deficiency type IA; and mitochondrial myopathy. Orthologous to human DNA2 (DNA replication helicase/nuclease 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856576.name: ATG7
856576.summary: Enables Atg12 activating enzyme activity; Atg8 activating enzyme activity; and identical protein binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cytoplasm to vacuole targeting by the Cvt pathway; piecemeal microautophagy of the nucleus; and post-translational protein modification. Located in cytosol; membrane; and phagophore assembly site. Is extrinsic component of phagophore assembly site membrane. Used to study nervous system disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 31. Orthologous to human ATG7 (autophagy related 7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856596.name: PTH1
856596.summary: Enables peptidyl-tRNA hydrolase activity. Involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Is active in mitochondrial matrix. Orthologous to human PTRH1 (peptidyl-tRNA hydrolase 1 homolog). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856600.name: EGD2
856600.summary: Enables phospholipid binding activity and unfolded protein binding activity. Involved in cotranslational protein targeting to membrane. Located in cytoplasm. Part of nascent polypeptide-associated complex. Orthologous to several human genes including NACA2 (nascent polypeptide associated complex subunit alpha 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856610.name: RPS4B
856610.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in translation. Part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPS4X (ribosomal protein S4 X-linked); RPS4Y1 (ribosomal protein S4 Y-linked 1); and RPS4Y2 (ribosomal protein S4 Y-linked 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856612.name: SCH9
856612.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription; positive regulation of hydrogen sulfide biosynthetic process; and regulation of sphingolipid biosynthetic process. Located in chromatin; fungal-type vacuole membrane; and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including breast cancer (multiple); gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); glucose metabolism disease (multiple); pancreatic cancer (multiple); and reproductive organ cancer (multiple). Orthologous to human AKT1 (AKT serine/threonine kinase 1); AKT2 (AKT serine/threonine kinase 2); and AKT3 (AKT serine/threonine kinase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856613.name: SKN7
856613.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity and phosphorelay response regulator activity. Involved in several processes, including regulation of endoplasmic reticulum unfolded protein response; response to singlet oxygen; and transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Orthologous to several human genes including HSFY1 (heat shock transcription factor Y-linked 1); HSFY2 (heat shock transcription factor Y-linked 2); and HSFX1 (heat shock transcription factor family, X-linked 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856646.name: CAN1
856646.summary: Enables L-arginine transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in L-arginine transmembrane transport. Located in eisosome and plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in retinitis pigmentosa 68. Orthologous to human SLC7A14 (solute carrier family 7 member 14) and SLC7A4 (solute carrier family 7 member 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856654.name: HAT2
856654.summary: Enables histone binding activity. Contributes to histone acetyltransferase activity. Involved in subtelomeric heterochromatin formation. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Part of histone acetyltransferase complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in X-linked spermatogenic failure 9. Orthologous to human RBBP4 (RB binding protein 4, chromatin remodeling factor) and RBBP7 (RB binding protein 7, chromatin remodeling factor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856656.name: RPL12A
856656.summary: Predicted to enable large ribosomal subunit rRNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in ribosomal large subunit assembly. Acts upstream of or within ribophagy. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in systemic lupus erythematosus. Orthologous to human RPL12 (ribosomal protein L12). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856657.name: MAK10
856657.summary: Contributes to protein-N-terminal amino-acid acetyltransferase activity. Involved in N-terminal protein amino acid acetylation and macroautophagy. Located in cytoplasm. Part of NatC complex. Orthologous to human NAA35 (N-alpha-acetyltransferase 35, NatC auxiliary subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856662.name: PAU2
856662.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of cell wall. Predicted to be involved in fungal-type cell wall organization. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in fungal-type cell wall. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856678.name: MTC7
856678.summary: Is active in cytosol. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856689.name: RIP1
856689.summary: Enables quinol-cytochrome-c reductase activity. Involved in mitochondrial electron transport, ubiquinol to cytochrome c. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Part of respiratory chain complex III. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial complex III deficiency. Orthologous to several human genes including UQCRFS1 (ubiquinol-cytochrome c reductase, Rieske iron-sulfur polypeptide 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856702.name: VAC8
856702.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity and protein-membrane adaptor activity. Involved in several processes, including Cvt vesicle assembly; macroautophagy; and vacuole organization. Acts upstream of or within establishment of organelle localization; protein localization to phagophore assembly site; and protein-containing complex localization. Located in several cellular components, including fungal-type vacuole membrane; nuclear membrane; and nucleus-vacuole junction. Part of Myo2p-Vac17p-Vac8p transport complex. Orthologous to human ARMC3 (armadillo repeat containing 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856704.name: UBC8
856704.summary: Enables ubiquitin-protein transferase activity. Involved in mitochondrial outer membrane translocase complex assembly; negative regulation of gluconeogenesis; and proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Located in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human UBE2H (ubiquitin conjugating enzyme E2 H). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856709.name: GCN4
856709.description: amino acid starvation-responsive transcription factor GCN4
856709.otherdesignations: amino acid starvation-responsive transcription factor GCN4
856709.nomenclaturename: amino acid starvation-responsive transcription factor GCN4
856709.summary: Enables several functions, including DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; TFIID-class transcription factor complex binding activity; and mediator complex binding activity. Involved in several processes, including positive regulation of cellular response to amino acid starvation; protein localization to nuclear periphery; and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856713.name: VAB2
856713.summary: Involved in endosome organization and regulation of protein localization. Located in endosome. Part of BLOC-1 complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856718.name: MNN1
856718.summary: Enables alpha-1,3-mannosyltransferase activity. Involved in N-glycan processing and protein O-linked glycosylation. Located in Golgi apparatus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856737.name: AFG3
856737.summary: Enables ATP hydrolysis activity; membrane protein dislocase activity; and metallopeptidase activity. Involved in several processes, including protein catabolic process; protein import into mitochondrial matrix; and protein maturation. Located in mitochondrial inner boundary membrane. Part of m-AAA complex. Used to study hereditary spastic paraplegia; optic atrophy 12; and spinocerebellar ataxia 28. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in optic atrophy 12; spastic ataxia; spastic ataxia 5; and spinocerebellar ataxia 28. Orthologous to human AFG3L2 (AFG3 like matrix AAA peptidase subunit 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856739.name: ISC1
856739.summary: Enables inositol phosphosphingolipid phospholipase activity. Involved in cellular response to hydroxyurea; regulation of mitotic cell cycle spindle assembly checkpoint; and sphingolipid metabolic process. Located in endoplasmic reticulum and mitochondrial outer membrane. Orthologous to human SMPD2 (sphingomyelin phosphodiesterase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856741.name: GPA2
856741.summary: Enables GTPase activity. Involved in several processes, including glucose mediated signaling pathway; invasive growth in response to glucose limitation; and pseudohyphal growth. Located in cytoplasm and plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Sturge-Weber syndrome; autosomal dominant hypocalcemia 2; color blindness (multiple); familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia 2; and night blindness (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including GNAI1 (G protein subunit alpha i1); GNAI2 (G protein subunit alpha i2); and GNAI3 (G protein subunit alpha i3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856763.name: GLN3
856763.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in cytosol and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856765.name: MXR1
856765.summary: Enables peptide-methionine (S)-S-oxide reductase activity. Involved in cellular response to oxidative stress. Located in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human MSRA (methionine sulfoxide reductase A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856772.name: CAJ1
856772.summary: Enables phosphatidylinositol phosphate binding activity. Predicted to be involved in protein folding and protein import into peroxisome matrix. Located in cytosol and plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856776.name: RSM18
856776.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial small ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPS18A (mitochondrial ribosomal protein S18A) and MRPS18C (mitochondrial ribosomal protein S18C). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856783.name: FCY2
856783.summary: Enables cytidine transmembrane transporter activity and nucleobase transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in cytidine transport; cytosine transport; and purine-containing compound transmembrane transport. Located in plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856784.name: RPL34A
856784.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in ribosome biogenesis. Part of preribosome, large subunit precursor. Orthologous to human RPL34 (ribosomal protein L34). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856786.name: PET117
856786.summary: Involved in mitochondrial respiratory chain complex IV assembly. Located in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial complex IV deficiency nuclear type 19. Orthologous to human PET117 (PET117 cytochrome c oxidase chaperone). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856787.name: PCL6
856787.summary: Predicted to enable cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase regulator activity. Involved in regulation of glycogen biosynthetic process and regulation of glycogen catabolic process. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be part of cyclin-dependent protein kinase holoenzyme complex. Predicted to be active in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856788.name: FCY21
856788.summary: Enables nucleobase transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in cytosine transport. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856794.name: ICL1
856794.summary: Enables isocitrate lyase activity. Involved in glyoxylate cycle. Located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856805.name: RPS24A
856805.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Located in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Diamond-blackfan anemia 3. Orthologous to human RPS24 (ribosomal protein S24). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856817.name: GET2
856817.summary: Enables protein-membrane adaptor activity and transmembrane protein transporter activity. Contributes to membrane insertase activity. Involved in several processes, including establishment of protein localization to endoplasmic reticulum membrane; mitophagy; and tail-anchored membrane protein insertion into ER membrane. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Part of GET complex. Is active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856825.name: MET6
856825.summary: Enables 5-methyltetrahydropteroyltriglutamate-homocysteine S-methyltransferase activity. Involved in L-methionine biosynthetic process. Located in cytoplasm and plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856831.name: RAD51
856831.summary: Enables DNA binding activity; catalytic activity, acting on DNA; and identical protein binding activity. Involved in DNA metabolic process and G2/M transition of mitotic cell cycle. Acts upstream of or within double-strand break repair via break-induced replication. Located in condensed nuclear chromosome and mitochondrial matrix. Is active in mitochondrial chromosome. Used to study breast cancer; colorectal cancer; and primary ovarian insufficiency. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Fanconi anemia complementation group R; breast cancer; mirror movements 2; and ovarian cancer. Orthologous to human RAD51 (RAD51 recombinase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856840.name: SSA4
856840.summary: Enables unfolded protein binding activity. Involved in SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane, translocation and protein folding. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including artery disease (multiple); autoimmune disease of musculoskeletal system (multiple); lung disease (multiple); neurodegenerative disease (multiple); and schizophrenia (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including HSPA1L (heat shock protein family A (Hsp70) member 1 like); HSPA1A (heat shock protein family A (Hsp70) member 1A); and HSPA1B (heat shock protein family A (Hsp70) member 1B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856850.name: BOI2
856850.summary: Enables phospholipid binding activity. Involved in several processes, including budding cell apical bud growth; septum digestion after cytokinesis; and vesicle fusion to plasma membrane. Located in cellular bud neck. Is active in cellular bud. Orthologous to human IPCEF1 (interaction protein for cytohesin exchange factors 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856852.name: SLX8
856852.description: SUMO-targeted ubiquitin ligase complex subunit SLX8
856852.otherdesignations: SUMO-targeted ubiquitin ligase complex subunit SLX8
856852.nomenclaturename: SUMO-targeted ubiquitin ligase complex subunit SLX8
856852.summary: Contributes to ubiquitin-protein transferase activity. Involved in DNA damage response; protein modification by small protein conjugation; and telomere maintenance. Located in kinetochore and nucleus. Part of SUMO-targeted ubiquitin ligase complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856866.name: SAK1
856866.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to glucose starvation; regulation of glycogen biosynthetic process; and regulation of pseudohyphal growth. Located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856868.name: RPS26B
856868.summary: Predicted to enable mRNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in maturation of LSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA); ribosomal subunit export from nucleus; and ribosome assembly. Part of 90S preribosome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Diamond-Blackfan anemia 10. Orthologous to several human genes including RPS26 (ribosomal protein S26). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856888.name: FTR1
856888.summary: Contributes to iron ion transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in arsenate ion transmembrane transport and iron ion import across cell outer membrane. Located in plasma membrane. Part of high-affinity iron permease complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856909.name: RAD4
856909.summary: Enables single-strand break-containing DNA binding activity. Involved in DNA metabolic process; negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Part of nucleotide-excision repair factor 2 complex. Used to study xeroderma pigmentosum. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pancreatic cancer; serous cystadenocarcinoma; xeroderma pigmentosum; and xeroderma pigmentosum group C. Orthologous to human XPC (XPC complex subunit, DNA damage recognition and repair factor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

856911.name: CHD1
856911.summary: Enables DNA binding activity; histone H3K4me3 reader activity; and nucleosome array spacer activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA-templated transcription; double-strand break repair; and regulation of transcriptional start site selection at RNA polymerase II promoter. Located in nucleolar chromatin. Part of SAGA complex and SLIK (SAGA-like) complex. Is active in site of double-strand break. Used to study prostate cancer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in castration-resistant prostate carcinoma; developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 94; and prostate cancer. Orthologous to human CHD1 (chromodomain helicase DNA binding protein 1) and CHD2 (chromodomain helicase DNA binding protein 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856913.name: DNF1
856913.summary: Enables flippase activity and identical protein binding activity. Involved in several processes, including endocytosis; intracellular protein transport; and lipid translocation. Located in mating projection tip membrane. Part of phospholipid-translocating ATPase complex. Is active in plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in benign recurrent intrahepatic cholestasis 1; intrahepatic cholestasis; intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy 1; and progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis 1. Orthologous to several human genes including ATP10A (ATPase phospholipid transporting 10A (putative)); ATP10B (ATPase phospholipid transporting 10B (putative)); and ATP10D (ATPase phospholipid transporting 10D (putative)). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856924.name: BMH1
856924.summary: Enables several functions, including DNA replication origin binding activity; RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity; and phosphoserine residue binding activity. Involved in several processes, including aggresome assembly; chitin biosynthetic process; and intracellular signal transduction. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human YWHAE (tyrosine 3-monooxygenase/tryptophan 5-monooxygenase activation protein epsilon). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

856925.name: PDA1
856925.summary: Enables pyruvate dehydrogenase (acetyl-transferring) activity. Involved in pseudohyphal growth and pyruvate decarboxylation to acetyl-CoA. Located in mitochondrial nucleoid. Part of pyruvate dehydrogenase complex. Used to study pyruvate decarboxylase deficiency. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pyruvate decarboxylase deficiency and spermatogenic failure 70. Orthologous to human PDHA1 (pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 subunit alpha 1) and PDHA2 (pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 subunit alpha 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

2539240.name: ght5
2539240.description: plasma membrane high-affinity glucose/fructose:proton symporter Ght5
2539240.otherdesignations: plasma membrane high-affinity glucose/fructose:proton symporter Ght5
2539240.nomenclaturename: plasma membrane high-affinity glucose/fructose:proton symporter Ght5
